# Moon colour map

`app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/moon_map.webp` is the 1024×512 colour map (`lroc_color_poles_1k.jpg`)
from NASA's **CGI Moon Kit**, downloaded 2026-11-19 from <https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720>, re-encoded
as WebP (quality 82). Equirectangular, centred on 0° longitude, built from Lunar Reconnaissance
Orbiter (LRO) data.

- Credit: **NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio**
- Use: NASA imagery is generally not copyrighted; see NASA's media usage guidelines
  (<https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/>). Optimised for looks, not science.

Used by Solstice to draw a realistic moon in its phase (the moon card, the moon button and the night
sun path).
